questions.q: What was the great feast the day Isaac was weaned?
choices: A celebration of Isaac coming off the breast at about three years old
questions.explain: The mothers gave their sons suck three years (2 Maccabees 7:27). It was not a birthday celebration.

questions.q: Why did God tell Abraham to hearken to Sarah about Hagar and Ishmael?
choices: Hagar wanted to return to Egypt
In Isaac shall thy seed be called
questions.explain: Sarah was on point; Isaac is the child of the promise. Ishmael would still be made a nation.

questions.q: Why could Ishmael not die of thirst in the wilderness?
choices: The prophecy that he would become a great nation stood over him
questions.explain: God heard the voice of the lad and opened Hagar's eyes to a well of water.
There Abraham and Abimelech sware both of them; the seven ewe lambs were a witness that Abraham digged the well.
